name: First evaluation
description: A full hour: history, movement testing, first treatment, and your written plan.

name: Follow-up visit
description: One-on-one treatment with your own therapist — hands-on care, exercise, and a progress check.

name: Post-surgical rehab
description: Protocol-based recovery after joint replacement, ACL, rotator cuff, and spine surgery, coordinated with your surgeon.

name: Sports injury rehab
description: Sprains, strains, and overuse injuries, with sport-specific drills and a clear return-to-play test.

name: Dry needling
description: Targeted release for stubborn trigger points, added to a visit when it will help.

name: Manual therapy
description: Joint mobilization and soft-tissue work to calm pain and free up movement.

name: Running gait analysis
description: Slow-motion video on the treadmill, a breakdown of what we see, and the three fixes that matter.

name: Balance & fall prevention
description: Testing and training to stay steady on stairs, curbs, and uneven ground.
